name: app
//preBuildHooks: Rebuilds the backend mod and re-embeds its jar before every Go build, so
the jar baked into the app is never stale. Runs for `wails build` and for
`wails dev`, including each hot restart. Gradle is incremental and the jar
is byte-reproducible, so an unchanged backend costs a couple of seconds and
leaves the embedded file untouched. Hooks run with the working directory
set to build/bin, hence the ../../.. prefix; `powershell` rather than
`pwsh` because Windows PowerShell is what ships with the OS.
